_comment_chain: Two 3-link punch techniques. Chain A (LMB-RMB-LMB) plays jab -> hook -> combo. Chain B (LMB-LMB-RMB) plays jab -> jab -> hook. Both share a slot-0 jab; the runtime locks the technique on press 2 (which button matches slot 1 of which technique). Cancel-open auto-detects from each clip's hand-velocity scan.

one_handed._comment_running: When the player is sprinting at chain-finisher time, the final attack swaps to the running slot's first attack instead of the locked technique's last clip. Single-clip chain (no further branches).

two_handed._comment: Unarmed has no two-handed grip; light slot mirrors one-handed for fallback.
